text: Six kilometres to Wilcza Góra. In the morning I walk it, snow or no snow. My mother has kept the goose for me.
It bit me. It's nothing. It's only a scratch, it's... it's nothing.
Tell my mother... I was nearly home. Nearly home.
Stay together! Keep together and run, don't stop for anything!
I can't... God forgive me. ...The bar! The bar, get it down!
